steps.1: If you have both the Lover and the Kidnapper in your hand and both are activated, the Kidnapper takes precedence.
If a player takes the Lover from your hand due to the Fence's action, you are eliminated, because the Fence also performs the SEE action.
If a player takes the Lover from your hand due to the Kidnapper's action, you are not eliminated, Stealing is not equal to Seeing.
Not activated when sacrificed by the Sacrifice.
If you have both the Lover and the Two-Faced in your hand and both are activated, the Two-Faced takes precedence.
The Lover is not activated by the Negotiator's action.
The Lover is not activated by the Speculator's action.
The Lover is not activated by the Comparator's action.
If a player takes the Lover from your hand due to the Advanced Dealer's action, you are not eliminated, Stealing is not equal to Seeing.
If a player takes the Lover from your hand due to the Advanced Cartomancer's action, you are not eliminated, Stealing is not equal to Seeing.
If the Lover is the card chosen by the Manipulator. The player who had the Lover in their hand is not eliminated, Stealing is not equal to Seeing.
If it is blocked by the Dictator and the Lover's conditions are met, it is not activated; if it is guessed, it must be discarded as if it were another card, without eliminating the player.
The Lover's power is valid during the Zombies' action.
It works normally for the Discriminator; it protects the other cards from the guess, but if the player says the Lover's type (Secret), you are eliminated.
When playing as a duo, if your partner asks to see your cards, you are eliminated.
Cannot choose a player who has a Guardian in their Field.
If all players already have the maximum number of cards or are protected. The Angel loses its action.
The Angel can revive players who are dead.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Angel's action on your partner.

Consider the current hand card limit. If it is 3, you can revive cards for players who have fewer than 3 cards in hand. If it is 1, you can only use the Angel's power on players who have already been eliminated.

*COUNTERSPELL:* If you choose the player who has the Sacrifice in their Field, the player must take a card from the discard pile. If they already have the maximum number of cards in hand, this card goes to their Reserve. After taking the card from the discard pile, the player must place the Sacrifice in the Discard Pile.
If you are the target of the Gossiper while you have the Helper in your hand. The Helper's power should not be activated.
If you have the Loan Shark and the Helper in your hand during a comparison. Both must be activated.
If it is reflected. The Reflex does not choose a new number; if the target is eliminated, the coin goes to the player that used the Assassin.
If the Reflex needs to reflect the action of your own Assassin against you. The action occurs normally.
If there are no available targets. The Assassin loses its action.
The Assassin cannot try to guess another player's Reserve card.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Assassin's action on your partner.
When playing as a duo, the target can reflect the Assassin onto their partner.
If your target uses a Two-Faced to protect themselves. The Spy's action is canceled.
If there are no available targets. The Spy loses its action.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Spy's action on your partner.
If you are protected by a Guardian. The Guardian cannot be stolen by a Thief.
If you are protected by a Guardian during a Shapeshifter's action. The Shapeshifter can copy one of your cards, but cannot use it against you.
If you are protected by a Guardian. Cannot be chosen as a target of an Angel.
If you are protected by a Guardian. Cannot be chosen as a target of a Lucky.
If you are protected by a Guardian. The Judge can cancel your protection.
If you are protected by a Guardian. Protects your Field from *Judge, Thief, Dealer, Usurper and Troublemaker.*
If you are protected by a Guardian. Protects your from receiving an Reserve card.
When playing as a duo, the Guardian's power also applies to your partner.
Cannot copy cards of type Permanent, Reactive, Turn, Automatic or Secret.
Can copy cards from a protected Field, but cannot use the action on players protected by: *Guardian, Security, Bodyguard and Reflex.*
If there are no Immediate cards in any Field or in the Discard pile. The Shapeshifter loses its action.
Can copy cards that are blocked by the Dictator, because the block is through the number, and the Shapeshifter copies the power, but doesn't use the entire card, so its number is still 6.
If one of your targets has the Lover in hand, it will not be activated.
If one of your targets has the Two-Faced in hand, it will not be activated.
If the Reflex needs to reflect the action of your own Negotiator against you. Swap with the other target, or with the draw pile, if there is no other target.
If there is only one target available. You can choose to swap with them or with the draw pile.
If there are no available targets. You can swap with the draw pile.
If one of your targets protects themselves with a Bodyguard. They must choose whether the other target swaps with you or with the draw pile.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Negotiator's action on your partner.
Only the cards in your hand count for the sum, the Poor that was played does not count.
If any player is eliminated in the comparison, the winner of the comparison gains one coin.
If a player runs out of cards during the comparison, their sum is zero.
If the Reflex needs to reflect the action of your own Poor against you. The Poor loses its action.
If there are no available targets. The Poor loses its action.
If at least one of your targets protects themselves with a Bodyguard. The Poor loses its action.
In Measure of the Next, adjacent players also participate in the comparison. Only the player with the *HIGHEST* sum loses a card.
When playing as a duo, you CANNOT use the Poor's action on your partner.
When playing as a duo, the pair can choose which of the two should participate in the comparison. Without looking at the other's cards.
The value of your sum should only be revealed after the pairs decide who will participate in the comparison.
Only the cards in your hand count for the sum, the Rich that was played does not count.
If any player is eliminated in the comparison, the winner of the comparison gains one coin.
If a player runs out of cards during the comparison, their sum is zero.
If the Reflex needs to reflect the action of your own Rich against you. The Rich loses its action.
If there are no available targets. The Rich loses its action.
If at least one of your targets protects themselves with a Bodyguard. The Rich loses its action.
In Measure of the Next, adjacent players also participate in the comparison. Only the player with the *LOWEST* sum loses a card.
When playing as a duo, you CANNOT use the Rich's action on your partner.
When playing as a duo, the pair can choose which of the two should participate in the comparison. Without looking at the other's cards.
The value of your sum should only be revealed after the pairs decide who will participate in the comparison.
If you take the Lover from a player's hand due to the Kidnapper's action, the player is not eliminated, *Stealing* is not equal to *Seeing*.
If you have the Catcher and the Kidnapper in your hand and both are activated, the Catcher takes precedence.
If you use the Assassin and the target uses Reflex to return the action against you. The Kidnapper will not be activated.
If you have the Kidnapper in hand during the Shooter's action. The Kidnapper is not activated.
If the Dictator has blocked the Kidnapper. The Kidnapper will not be activated this round.
If your victim has a Two-Faced, it should not be activated.
If you have the Bodyguard and the Kidnapper in your hand and both are activated, the Kidnapper takes precedence.
If you have the Wanted and the Kidnapper in your hand and both are activated, the Kidnapper takes precedence.
If you have the Reflex and the Kidnapper in your hand and both are activated, the Reflex takes precedence.
Not allowed to react when you were the player who started the action.
If guessed by the Seer, you don't need to replace the card, because you take one from the player who attacked.
If your victim has a Virus, it should be activated.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Kidnapper to protect your partner.
If your target protects themselves with a Kidnapper you lose the action. The target doesn't need to replace the card, because they will take one from you.
If your target protects themselves with a Bodyguard. The Seer's action is completely canceled, even if you said 0.
All cards that have the chosen number in your target's hand count for coins and must be replaced.
If there are no available targets. The Seer loses its action.
If it is reflected. The Reflex cannot change the chosen number, but the point still goes to whoever used the Seer.
If the Reflex needs to reflect the action of your own Seer against you. The action occurs normally.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Seer's action on your partner.
The Sentinel is not an action against players field, so it is not blocked by the Security.
The player blocked by the Sentinel still participates in any action against them.
If the Sentinel is removed from your Field, the target returns to play in the round.
If there are no available targets. The Sentinel loses its action.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Sentinel's action on your partner.
If there are no available targets, due to protections like Guardian and Bodyguard. The Shooter loses its action.
Does not affect the player who chose the number.
If one of the targets has more than one card of the chosen number in hand, they lose each one of them.
The Kidnapper is not activated by the Shooter's action.
When playing as a duo, the partner of the player who chose the number is also affected by the action.

*RICOCHET:* If a player has the Reflex during the Shooter's action. The player with the Reflex must choose a new number and the Shooter player becomes the target of the action. The action ends with whoever played the Reflex, who doesn't count as a target. Can be reflected again.
Not allowed to react when you were the player who started the action.
If you have the Reflex and the Two-Faced in your hand and both are activated, the Reflex takes precedence.
The Two-Faced is not activated by the Kidnapper. Reactive cards do not activate Reactive cards.
The Two-Faced is not activated by the Comparator.
The Two-Faced is not activated by the Negotiator. Swap action.
The Two-Faced is not activated by the Speculator. Swap action.
The Two-Faced is not activated by the Manipulator. Steal action.
The Two-Faced is not activated by the Fence. Steal action.
The Two-Faced is not activated by the Advanced Cartomancer. Steal action.
The Two-Faced is not activated by the Advanced Dealer. Steal action.
If the Dictator has blocked the Two-Faced. The Two-Faced will not be activated.
If you have the Two-Faced and the Virus in your hand and both are activated, the Two-Faced takes precedence.
If your partner asks to see your cards while you have the Two-Faced in hand, it will be activated.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Two-Faced to protect your partner.
If you block the Traitor and a player takes it during the round, the player must discard the Traitor and restart their turn, drawing a new card.
The blocked card can be played without action, if it's the only option.
If the blocked card is of Permanent or Turn type and needs to be played, it has no action and can go directly to the Discard pile.
If the Dictator is deactivated or removed from the Field while it is active, the blocked card becomes valid again.

The Shapeshifter can copy cards that are blocked by the Dictator, because the block is through the number, and the Shapeshifter copies the power, but doesn't use the entire card, so its number is still 6. If the blocked number is 6, the Shapeshifter has no power.
If the Entrepreneur is stolen by the Thief, the Thief player can make an investment.
If the Entrepreneur is removed from your Field, is deactivated or you don't win the game. Your Investment will be lost.
Even if the Entrepreneur is reactivated or returned to your Field, the investment is lost. In this case, you can make a new investment.
If a Zombie eliminates all the remaining players with only one action and have the Entrepreneur in their field, They receive 2 coins.
When playing as a duo, the duo's coins are shared, so only one investment per duo is allowed.
Only the cards in your hand count for the sum, the leader does not count.
If a player is eliminated in the Incendiary's action, the player who wins the comparison gets the coin, not the one who used the Incendiary.
If a player runs out of cards during the comparison, their sum is zero.
If one of your targets protects themselves with a Bodyguard. You must enter the comparison in their place.
If there is only one target available, you must participate in the comparison.
If there are no available targets. The Incendiary loses its action.
In case of a tie, no one loses a card.
When playing as a duo, you CANNOT use the Incendiary's action on your partner.
When playing as a duo, if you need to participate in the comparison, the pair can choose which of the two should participate. Without looking at the other's cards.
The sum values should only be revealed after the pairs decide who will participate in the comparison.
In infinite mode, if a player is eliminated in the Incendiary's action, the winner of the comparison gains one coin and the one who played the Incendiary gains one.
The Judge can deactivate a Guardian.
Cannot deactivate another card in a Field protected by the Guardian.
Cannot deactivate another card in a Field protected by Security before deactivating it.
If there are no cards of Permanent or Turn type in any Field, no cards in the Discard pile and no player has a Reserve card. The Judge loses its action.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Judge's action on your partner.
Players with the Guardian do not receive Bad Omen markers.
The player can defend themselves with the Bodyguard, in which case they do not receive a marker.
If the chosen player has the Sacrifice and it is activated, the Bad Omen gains one coin, but the Sacrifice player returns to the game following the card's rule.
If neither of the two final players has the true marker, you gain nothing.
If players are eliminated at the same time, skipping the moment when only two players survive, the Bad Omen is not activated.
If you bet on yourself and win, you are eliminated and gain one coin.
The Bad Omen does not give an extra coin for eliminating a player using its action, only the coin already promised on the card.
If there are no available targets, loses the action.
If the Bad Omen is played when there are already only 2 players alive, the markers must be shuffled and drawn by luck.
Must give a marker to your Partner as well.
If the target takes the Traitor, executes its action normally.
If there are no cards in the discard pile. The Necromancer loses its action.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Necromancer's action on your partner.
Cannot choose a player who has the Guardian in their Field.
If you are eliminated with the Lucky in your Field, the Lucky remains valid.
Cannot bet on yourself.
If the Lucky is removed from your Field, it is deactivated.
If there are no available targets. The Lucky loses its action.
When playing as a duo, the Lucky cannot be used on your partner.
If you have the Gossiper in hand, you can discard it during the Dealer's action, without action.
If you draw the Traitor during the Dealer's action, you can discard it without action.
Works for the Lover in the same way as if guessing a number, can eliminate the player, but only if you guess the Lover's type.
If there are no available targets, loses the action.
Kidnapper defends normally from the action.
During Inertia, players who have the guessed card lose the card and cannot replace it.
If blocked by the Dictator, it is not activated.
Can be used in the comparison, but all players will know.
If you don't have a Leader, the sum is 0.
The player can use the Loan Shark, but the sum remains only the Leader's value. The Loan Shark's action will only change cards in hand.
The Player can still use the Politician, changing the value of their Leader for the value of a Leader at the side.
During Inertia, the Poisoner should only be replaced in the next round.
The Forger's action applies when targeted by Zombies.
Activates the Gossiper, even if the Leader's value is less than 7.
If drawn by the Loan Shark, consider the Leader's value.
Dictator does not affect the Forger, since it won't be played.
For *SEE* actions, the Forger is worth 10.
In Limit Decree, the Forger is worth 10.
Cannot choose a player who has the Guardian in their Field.
If you are eliminated with the Inspector in your Field, the Inspector remains valid.
If the Inspector is removed from your Field, it is deactivated.
If there are no available targets. The Inspector loses its action.
When playing as a duo, the Inspector cannot be used on your partner.
Can be played without action during the Dealer's power.
Can be played without action during the Infiltrator's power.
If there are no available targets. The Gossiper loses its action.
If the Reflex needs to reflect the action of your own Gossiper against you. The action occurs normally.
Does not activate the Loan Shark.
Does not activate the Helper.
If activated during the round it was blocked by the Dictator, the Gossiper should not be played.
During Hegemony, it is allowed to play the Gossiper without meeting the prerequisite, since the leader will be considered as another card.

*GOSSIP CIRCLE:* If the Gossiper is reflected, all players must tell the sum of their cards only to the player next to them, in the game order. No defense or reaction should be considered in this action.

Permanent or Turn cards that are still Leaders lose their action when targeted by the Manager. If they are already in the Permanent area, they are not affected. Cards: *Lucky, Inspector, Entrepreneur, Politician, Sacrifice, Security, Sentinel, Dictator, Denier, Bad Omen and Cheater.*

Permanent or Turn cards that are placed as Leader by the Manager have no action, must be discarded normally in the next turn. Cards: *Guardian, Lucky, Inspector, Entrepreneur, Politician, Sacrifice, Security, Sentinel, Dictator, Denier, Bad Omen and Cheater.*
Players protected by the Guardian cannot be chosen as targets.
If you choose the player who has Security in their Field, the card that must return to hand is Security, since the Leader is part of the Field being protected.
Lover is not activated, because it wasn't seen in hand but rather as Leader.
Two-Faced cannot defend against the Manager, because it's not a see action.
If you don't have a Leader, the player draws the last card from the Discard pile.
Cannot steal from a player who has a Guardian in their Field.
Can only steal Security if the target has it in their Field.
If you steal the Lucky, remake the bet.
If you steal the Inspector, remake the bet.
If you steal the Bad Omen, remake the bet.
If you steal the Sentinel, choose a new person who cannot play.
If you steal the Dictator, choose a new number to be blocked.
Can steal from someone who has already been eliminated from the game.
If you steal the Sacrifice. The target loses the revival power and you must make a new sacrifice.
If you steal the Entrepreneur, you can Invest, if you have coins.
When playing as a duo, you can steal cards from your partner's Field to reactivate them.
*No special cases found.*
When playing as a duo, the Politician's power also applies to your partner.

*ELECTION (Advanced Politician):* If the second Politician is used while the first is in another player's Field, players who don't have a Politician and are not protected must give a card from their hand to the Politician they choose to vote for. The Politician who receives the most votes (cards) takes both Politician cards to their Field. The winning politician must, without looking, shuffle the received cards and then return them to their voters. If a Politician is moved to another Field, elections are held again.
If the new target of the action is eliminated, the player who started the action gets the coin.
Not allowed to react when you were the player who started the action.
If reflecting an Assassin, cannot change the chosen number.
Reflex cannot be used to protect against the Virus.
Reflex cannot be used to protect against the Catcher.
Reflects Lucky bets.
Reflects the Angel.
Not activated by the Troublemaker.
Not activated by the Advanced Cartomancer.
Cannot reflect the Detective's extra action.
Can reflect an action that has already been reflected to you, including to the player who used the previous Reflex.
Also reflects actions against your Field.
Cannot reflect reactions.
Has priority over Reactive cards.
When there is no other target available, must reflect to whoever used the action.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Reflex's action on your partner.

*RICOCHET:* If a player has the Reflex during the Shooter's action. The player with the Reflex must choose a new number and the Shooter player becomes the target of the action. The action ends with the Reflex, who doesn't count as a target. Can be reflected again.
If the Sacrifice is activated, you were not eliminated, so the player doesn't gain a coin and doesn't draw Laws.
Can sacrifice the Lover without being eliminated.
If the player chosen by the Bad Omen has the Sacrifice and it is activated, the Bad Omen gains one coin, but the Sacrifice player returns to the game following the card's rule.
If the Sacrifice leaves your Field and returns again, the sacrifice must be redone.
When playing as a duo, the Sacrifice's power applies to the first player in the duo to be eliminated. If the player was eliminated before the Sacrifice was played, they cannot use its power.
If you eliminate a player's last card, but they activate the Sacrifice to return to the game, the player was not eliminated, so you don't gain a coin.
If there are no cards in the Discard pile. The Usurper loses its action.
If there are no available targets, loses the action.
Can swap places with a player who has Security in their field, since no cards are being moved.
Does not activate the Virus, since the hand cards are not being moved.
During Measure of the Next, players adjacent to the target swap places with each other.
When playing as a duo, you can choose your partner as target.
In case of a tie, no one loses the card, everyone swaps the card with the draw pile.
Helper beats other Secret cards when used in comparison.
The Loan Shark can be used in the Comparator's action, perform the action normally, and decide which card from hand to use in the type comparison.
Does not activate the Two-Faced.
The player can show the Lover without being eliminated.
The player can show the Gossiper without meeting its prerequisites.
Even having a Denier in their Field, the player can show cards of the denied type.
The player can show the Wanted without being eliminated.
Reactive and Automatic cards can be shown without being activated. Cards: *Loan Shark, Catcher, Two-Faced, Gossiper, Bodyguard, Wanted, Reflex, Kidnapper and Virus.*
During Inertia, players who need to swap the card will not be able to do so, they will have to keep the shown card.
During Inertia, players without cards lose the comparison.
During Measure of the Next, you, the target and adjacent players show a card, only the owner of the most common card loses it, the other players swap the shown card.
During Action and Reaction, the eliminated player must draw a card, perform the Comparator's action and then discard the card even if they win, thus remaining eliminated.
When playing as a duo, the comparison participants must decide with their partner, without showing the cards, who will compare.
If there are no available targets, loses the action.
Two-Faced defends normally from the action.
Does not eliminate the Lover, since a swap action is not a *SEE* action.
Does not activate Two-Faced, since a swap action is not a *SEE* action.
Can discard the Gossiper without fulfilling the prerequisite, if it is the card to be eliminated.
Activates the Virus normally, the player who receives the Virus must perform the Virus action immediately after concluding the Speculator's action.
If there are no available targets, the action is lost.
If the player is eliminated during the *Action and Reaction*, they must draw a card, perform the Speculator's action, and then discard anyway, because they remain eliminated.
When playing as a duo, you cannot use the Speculator's action on your partner. If it's the only option, you lose the action.
In Infinite Mode, if you end up eliminating yourself with the Speculator's action, no one gains or loses coins.
Cannot be used to protect yourself from an action you initiated.
If you have both the Bodyguard and the Kidnapper in your hand and both are activated, the Kidnapper takes precedence.
If you have both the Bodyguard and the Reflex in your hand and both are activated, the Reflex takes precedence.
If you have both the Bodyguard and Two-Faced in your hand and both are activated, Two-Faced takes precedence.
Cannot block the Shapeshifter from copying one of your cards, but can block the copied action.
Can defend against bets, like the Lucky.
Cannot defend against reactions.
Can defend actions against your Field and Reserve.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Bodyguard's action to protect your partner.
Cannot react to an action that was initiated by yourself.
Does not react to Reactive cards.
Cannot be used to protect yourself from the Zombie's action because it does not activate Reactive cards. Cards: *Bodyguard and Wanted.*
If you have another Reactive card in your hand that is activated, it takes precedence over the Impostor. Cards: *Loan Shark, Two-Faced, Bodyguard, Wanted, Reflex, and Kidnapper.*
If you are the target of a *GUESS* action and the Kidnapper is in a Field or Discard pile, copy it, *see the Kidnapper's special cases.*
If you are the target of a *SEE* action and Two-Faced is in a Field or Discard pile, copy it, *see Two-Faced's special cases.*
If you are the target of an action and Reflex is in a Field or Discard pile, copy it, *see Reflex's special cases.*
If you are the target of an action and Bodyguard is in a Field or Discard pile, copy it, *see Bodyguard's special cases.*
If you are the target of a *COMPARE* action and the Loan Shark is in a Field or Discard pile, copy it, *see the Loan Shark's special cases.*
If you are the target of a *GUESS* action, the opponent guesses a number you have in your hand, and Wanted is in a Field or Discard pile, copy it, *see Wanted's special cases.*
If the Impostor is blocked by the Dictator, it is not activated.
If you are blocked by the Arbiter, you can still react with the Impostor.
Cannot copy cards of the Immediate, Permanent, Turn, Automatic, or Secret type.
Can copy cards from a protected Field, but cannot use the action on protected players. Cards: *Bodyguard, Guardian, Reflex, and Security.*
If there are no Reactive cards in any Field or in the Discard pile, the Impostor cannot be activated.
Can be used to protect your partner.
If you have both the Catcher and the Intrusive in hand and both are activated, the Catcher takes precedence.
The player who has Wanted must replace their card and continue in the game, not being eliminated and not gaining a coin.
If the Intrusive has been blocked by the Dictator, it is not activated.
If the player is blocked by the Arbiter, they can still use the Intrusive, if the prerequisites are met.
The player who used the reaction must replace the card they used and participate in the action used against them normally. Cards: *Loan Shark, Two-Faced, Bodyguard, Wanted, Reflex, and Kidnapper.*

If you have another reactive card in your hand that is activated by the action, you can use it normally without it being canceled. Cards: *Loan Shark, Two-Faced, Bodyguard, Wanted, Reflex, and Kidnapper.*
Reactions cannot be used against the Intrusive. Cards: *Loan Shark, Two-Faced, Bodyguard, Wanted, Reflex, and Kidnapper.*
Can block reactions against yourself.
Does not block your own reactions.

During Inertia, if the Intrusive is activated, the player and the target must only replace their cards in the next round, they become immune to actions. If they are participating in a comparison, their sum is zero.
When playing as a duo, the Intrusive's action is used against your partner.
When playing as a duo, your partner can use a second reaction to defend you if the first one is canceled by the Intrusive.
Reactive cards cannot be used as defense for a Player who has the Reactive or Automatic Denier on the Field, and they cannot use cards of this type to defend themselves from other players.

If you guess a card from someone who has Wanted, or someone guesses a card of yours while you have Wanted and the Denier is on your field, the owner of Wanted is not eliminated and does not gain a coin.
You can play the Gossiper without meeting the prerequisites while you have the Denier on the field, but it will have no action.
If you draw the Traitor while you have the Denier on the field, discard it and start your turn again.
If you receive the Virus while you have the Denier on the field, do not activate it, just keep it for yourself. You also do not participate in the Virus action under any circumstances.
Does not block the Shapeshifter's action of copying a card, but protects from the copied action, if it is against the Field.
Can be stolen by the Thief while still active.
When playing as a duo, Security's power also applies to your partner.
If you draw the Traitor during the Sneaky's action. Do not activate the Traitor's action, place it in a player's Reserve to be activated during their turn.
If only you are without a Reserve card, do not look at the card from the draw pile, just place it in your Reserve.
If there are no available targets or everyone, including you, already has a Reserve card, replace a Reserve card from some player.
Players protected by Security do not participate in the action.
When playing as a duo, you can choose your partner to receive the Reserve card.
If you don't have a Leader it is not Immediate, so the Cheater's action works.
If you draw the Gossiper as one of the two cards, you can choose to discard it even without meeting the prerequisites and keep the other drawn card.
If you draw the Traitor as one of the two cards, you can choose to discard it without losing a card and keep the other drawn card.
During Inertia, the Cheater is not activated.
During the Measure of Chaos, the Cheater is not activated.
When playing as a duo, the Cheater also works for your partner.
If a player runs out of cards during the comparison, their sum is zero.
If there are not enough cards, shuffle the discard pile into the draw pile.
During the Comparator's action, execute the Loan Shark normally, but instead of adding or subtracting, choose one of the cards from your hand to use in the comparison.
Works in conjunction with the Helper.

If you have the Advanced Helper and the Loan Shark in hand and both are activated at the same time, the Loan Shark's action must be executed. After the Loan Shark's action, you can choose whether to use the Advanced Helper and ignore the value of the stolen card.
Works in conjunction with the Politician. You can replace the value of a card that remained in your hand, you cannot use the Politician on the card you drew.
If the Poisoner is activated, the comparison will be made with the Leaders, even after drawing the card with the Loan Shark's action.
The Loan Shark is not activated by the Gossiper's action.
Cannot be activated if blocked by the Dictator.
Can be used when you yourself initiated the comparison.
When playing as a duo, you can only use the Loan Shark if you participate in the comparison.
The Catcher steals the player's entire turn, so the played card does not count as played by them. Any action initiated because of the card that was played happens with the owner of the Catcher.
The Leader does not actually belong to the player, which is why the Catcher can steal even from someone who has Security.
If the Catcher is blocked by the Dictator, it should not be activated until the end of the block.
Is not activated by Reactions.
If you have the Catcher and a reactive card in hand, the Catcher takes precedence.
The target's card takes the place of your Leader and the Catcher goes directly to the Discard pile.
If the target uses a card that has no action, such as Reactive, Automatic, or Hand cards, take the card anyway to be your new Leader.
Can play the Catcher, during your turn, without an action.
When playing as a duo, if it is your partner's turn while you have the Catcher in hand, it is activated normally.
Players with Guardian on their Field do not participate in the action.
Does not activate Reflex.
Players with Bodyguard can defend themselves.
The player who used the Troublemaker is also included in the action.
If all other players are protected, the Troublemaker loses the action.
If any player has the Virus in hand after the Troublemaker's action, *ALL* players execute the Virus action, except the one who had it at the start of the action.
When playing as a duo, the Troublemaker's action normally affects your partner.
Cannot take cards from the Field of a player who has a Guardian.
If the player has Security, you can only take the Security from their Field.
If you take the Lover from one of the targets, place it in the Discard pile and the target is eliminated. Continue the action only with the other target's card and a card from a Field.
If you choose a target who has Two-Faced, continue the action without them and then lose a card.
If the target uses Reflex on you. You must swap one of the cards from your hand with one of the cards you took.

If there is only one available target. Execute the action with only one target and a card from one Field. Consider yourself as the second target, you can choose to trade one of your card with one of the cards in the action.
If there are no cards in the Fields. Perform the action only with the players. Do not give back any card to the Draw Pile
If there are no available targets. The Cambist loses the action.

If the draw pile has fewer than 10 cards, shuffle the Discard pile into the draw pile before starting the action.

When a player uses an action to See the cards in your hand and you have the Intimidator, let the player see your cards. While you have the Intimidator in your hand, if the same player selects you again as a target of any action. Play your Intimidator, the player loses a card and you draw a new one.
If the Intimidator leaves your hand, the protection ends.
The opponent's action is not canceled, they only must lose the card after the action ends.
Any action that chooses you as a target must activate the Intimidator, even if it is something good.
The Shapeshifter choosing a card from your Field to be copied does not count as a target.
Global actions do not activate the Intimidator. Cards: *Troublemaker, Shooter, Advanced Cartomancer, and Advanced Beggar.*
In the Incendiary's action, the one who loses the card to the Intimidator is the one who used the Incendiary and not the one who compared against you.
If the Intimidator is blocked by the Dictator, it is not activated.

The opponent's reactions do not activate the Intimidator. However, if you are the target of an action and you use a reaction, the Intimidator is still activated after the reaction. Cards: *Loan Shark, Two-Faced, Bodyguard, Impostor, Wanted, Reflex, and Kidnapper.*
Only the Gossiper among the Automatic cards activates the Intimidator, because the other Automatic cards are not the opponent's choice. Cards: *Catcher, Gossiper, Intrusive, Traitor, and Virus.*

item10.imageAlt: Follow Clues from the Detective Character

steps.1: If included in the Follow Clues action of the Detective, activates the Intimidator.

If you are the target of Detective or Secret Agent with the Intimidator in your hand, without being seen by the player yet, the action will not activate the Intimidator, even though it is separated in steps, because it is the same turn yet. If the Intimidator is still in your hand in the next action you are the same player's target, you can activate it.
During the Measure of Inertia, you cannot replace the Intimidator, so keep it.
During the Measure of the Next, if you are one of the adjacent players, activates the Intimidator.
The Intimidator cannot be activated to protect your partner.
If you draw the Virus from a player's hand, Virus is not activated, since it goes direct to your Leader.
If you draw Two-Faced from a player's hand, it is not activated.
If the Reflex needs to reflect the action of your own Manipulator against you. The Manipulator loses the action.
If you draw the Lover, the target is not eliminated, Stealing is not the same as Seeing.
If you take a card that is blocked by the Dictator, the card is played without action.
If you draw the Gossiper, execute its action.
The drawn card goes to your Leader and the Manipulator goes to the Discard pile.
If there are no available targets, the Manipulator loses the action.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Manipulator's action on your partner.
If there is no available target, loses the action.
If the target has a Kidnapper, it is activated.
Can choose your partner for the action.
If no player has a card of the same type as the Leader in their hand, the Beggar loses the action.
If the player has no Leader, they do not participate in the action.

Reflex is not activated, because the Beggar is Global.
If the opponent places the Lover in their reserve, it is not activated, because they were not asked to *SEE* or *GUESS.*

Does not activate Two-Faced, because it is not a *SEE* action.

If blocked by the Dictator, Wanted is not activated.

If you are eliminated by the Traitor, you do not gain a coin for eliminating a player, because the Traitor is an automatic game action.
If the Traitor is blocked by the Dictator and a player draws it during the round, the player must discard the Traitor and restart their turn.
If you draw the Traitor during the Dealer's action, you can discard it without action.
If you draw the Traitor during the Sneaky's action. Do not activate the Traitor's action, place it in a player's Reserve to be activated during their turn.
If you draw the Traitor as one of the two cards in the Cheater's action, you can choose to discard it without losing a card and keep the other drawn card.
If you have only the Poor or the Rich in hand after discarding the Traitor, your sum is zero. After the action, you will be eliminated anyway. Cards: *Poor and Rich.*
If you end up with only the Gossiper after discarding the Traitor, the condition of having a card 7 or more is discarded.
If you have only Sacrifice in hand after discarding the Traitor, sacrifice the Traitor and draw a card from the graveyard; if it is the Traitor, you are eliminated.
If you are eliminated by the Traitor, you do not gain a coin, but lose one.

The Virus counts as one of the discarded cards; if you had two cards, draw one new card. But if you had only the Virus, you are eliminated.
The Virus is not activated by *SEE* actions, because the card is returned to its owner.
Is activated by the Kidnapper's action.
If you have both Two-Faced and the Virus in your hand and both are activated, Two-Faced takes precedence.
The Virus is not activated when drawn from the draw pile, from a Field, or from the Discard pile. And it is also not activated when placed on a Field or Reserve (which is part of the Field).
The Virus is not activated by the Opportunist.
If the Virus is blocked by the Dictator, it should not be activated.
If any player has the Virus in hand after the Troublemaker's action. *EVERYONE*, except them, executes the Virus action.
If you draw the Virus during the Manipulator's action, DO NOT execute the Virus action.
Placing the Virus in another player's Reserve does not cause it to be activated.

If the Virus is taken by the player who used the Cambist, wait until the end of the action to activate the Virus. When playing as a duo, if your partner activates the Virus that is in your hand, the action happens normally.
If you are the target of the Gossiper while having the Advanced Helper in hand. The Advanced Helper's power should not be activated.

If you have both the Advanced Helper and the Loan Shark in hand and both are activated at the same time, the Loan Shark's action must be executed. After the Loan Shark's action, you can choose whether to use the Advanced Helper and ignore the value of the stolen card.
If there are no cards in the Field, use the common Helper's action.
If your target uses a Two-Faced to protect themselves. The Secret Agent's action is canceled.
If there are no available targets. The Secret Agent loses the action.
If the target is protected with Security, you cannot see the Reserve card.
You can choose the Reserve card to be swapped with the draw pile.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Secret Agent's action on your partner.
Players with Guardian on their Field do not participate in the action.
Does not activate Reflex.
Players with Bodyguard can defend themselves.
Players with Security on the Field keep their Field and Reserve intact, but hand over the cards from their hand.

If all other players are protected, you must shuffle the cards from your hands, Reserve, and Field with the draw pile.
Includes cards from eliminated players.

If there are no cards in the graveyard. The Gravedigger loses the action.
If there are no available targets, loses the action.

If your target uses a Two-Faced to protect themselves. The Detective's action is canceled.

If the target is protected with Security, you cannot see the Reserve card.
If a player who has cards on the Field that have the same value as the cards in your target's hand also has an active Guardian, do not perform the extra action on that player.

If there are no cards in the Fields, do not perform the extra action on other players.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Detective's action on your partner.

Permanent or Turn cards that are still Leaders lose their action when they are the target of the Manager. If they are already in the Permanent area, they are not affected. Cards: *Arbiter, Dictator, Entrepreneur, Inspector, Bad Omen, Denier, Politician, Sacrifice, Security, Lucky, and Cheater.*

Permanent or Turn cards that are placed as Leader by the Manager have no action, they must be discarded normally in the next play. Cards: *Arbiter, Dictator, Entrepreneur, Inspector, Bad Omen, Denier, Politician, Sacrifice, Security, Lucky, and Cheater.*
Players protected by Guardian cannot be chosen as targets.
If you choose the player who has Security on their Field, the card that must be drawn to replace the Leader is Security, since the Leader is part of the Field that is being protected.
Lover is activated only if it comes from the target's Hand.
Two-Faced can defend against the Advanced Manager.
If you have no Leader, use the last card from the Discard pile instead.
If you draw the Traitor during the Advanced Manager's action, do not activate it, you can give it to the target.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Advanced Manager's action on your partner.
You are not protected from living players.
When playing as a duo, the Immortal's power also applies to your partner.
If your target uses a Two-Faced to protect themselves. The Infiltrator's action is canceled.
If there are no available targets. The Infiltrator loses the action.
If the target is protected with Security, you cannot see the Reserve card.
Even if the card you want to choose to be played is blocked by the Dictator, the target must use it, without action.
You can choose the Reserve card to be the next one to be used.
You can choose the Gossiper to be the next one to be used, even if it doesn't meet the preconditions.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Infiltrator's action on your partner.
Even if you are eliminated, the Advanced Necromancer remains valid until the end of action criteria is met.
If there are no Zombies, the Advanced Necromancer's power remains valid until the 2 rounds are over.
No special cases found.
Players protected by Guardian do not participate in the action.
Players protected by Security do not participate in the action.

If the player uses Bodyguard during the phase of drawing cards from the Field, that player does not participate in the Advanced Sneaky's action. But if the player uses Bodyguard only at the moment of receiving the Reserve card, the card removed from the Field does not return.
Reflex cannot protect from the Advanced Sneaky's action.
If all players have a Reserve card, replace someone's card with the chosen one.
If there are no cards in any player's Field, the Advanced Sneaky loses the action. Leaders count as Field cards.
When playing as a duo, you can choose your partner to receive the Reserve card.
Cannot take cards from a player who has Guardian on their Field.
Can be defended with a Reflex.
Can be defended with a Bodyguard.
If you try to draw a card from the hand of a player who has Two-Faced, draw only one card, but discard two.
Cannot take cards from the Field of a player who has active Security, except for Security itself.
If you have the Gossiper in hand, you can discard it during the Advanced Dealer's action, without action.
If you draw the Traitor during the Advanced Dealer's action, you can discard it without action.
Cannot take Reserve cards or from the graveyard.
If you take a card from another player's hand, they draw a new card.
If you take the Virus from a player, it is activated at the end of the Advanced Dealer's action, even if it doesn't stay in your hand.
When playing as a duo, you can take cards from your partner.
If you don't have a Leader it is not Immediate, so the Cheater's action works.
If you draw the Gossiper as one of the two cards, you can choose to discard it even without meeting the prerequisites and keep the other drawn card.
If you draw the Traitor as one of the two cards, you can choose to discard it without losing a card and keep the other drawn card.
During Inertia, the Cheater is not activated.
During the Measure of Chaos, the Cheater is not activated.
When playing as a duo, the Cheater also works for your partner.
If your target protects themselves with a Kidnapper you lose the action. The target does not need to replace the card, because they will take one of yours.
If your target protects themselves with a Bodyguard. The Seer's action is completely canceled, even having said 0.
All cards that have the chosen number in your target's hand count coins and must be replaced.
If there are no available targets. The Seer loses the action.
If it is reflected. The Reflex cannot change the chosen number, but the point still goes to the one who used the Seer.
If the Reflex needs to reflect the action of your own Seer against you. The action occurs normally.
When playing as a duo, you can use the Seer's action on your partner.
If eliminated by a Shapeshifter, the target must use the same action that the Shapeshifter copied.

The one who had the card stolen does not activate Action and Reaction, only the target of the card that was stolen by the Manipulator. The target must use the same action of the card that the Manipulator stole.

For cards with more than one target, the targets must choose together someone to participate in the action along with the attacker. Follow the special cases of the card in question. Cards: *Cambist and Incendiary.*
Global cards do not activate the Measure. Cards: *Troublemaker, Advanced Troublemaker, Shooter and Cartomancer.*
If the player was eliminated by the Speculator, they must draw a card, perform the Speculator's action and discard anyway, because they remain eliminated.
Each target of the Advanced Seer must use the action of a common Seer only.
No special cases found.
If you draw the Traitor, execute its action; if you remain alive, the number that will count for the Ascendant is from the card played after the Traitor.
The Manager's target does not activate the Ascendant.
If the Leader of the player who would break the Ascendant rule is stolen, the person who used the Catcher will be the one punished for breaking the Ascendant.
In case of a tie, the player, among the tied ones, with the lowest value card as Leader will be the target. If the tie persists, the target is decided by the player performing the action.
Permanent and Turn Type cards go to the target's Field.
Secret or Reactive cards being played without action do not need to be voted on.
The person voted for by the Traitor's action must play a card, and use the action, without drawing another to replace it.
Global cards do not need to be voted on.
Zombies' actions are also voted on by the table.
Protected targets cannot be voted for.
When playing as a duo, you cannot vote for your partner to be the target of a card, even if it is a good one.
Those who have already formed a couple can no longer form with other players, even if the Leader is the same. And even if their couple is eliminated.
Only cards that are on the Leader at the same time are considered.
If a player places a number that is on the Leader of more than one player who does not yet have a couple, they can choose with whom they will form the couple.
The Manager's target does not activate the Couples Decree.
If the Leader of the player who would form a couple in the Couples Decree is stolen, the person who used the Catcher will form the couple.
During this Decree, no card is activated. Card: *Traitor.*
The card placed as Leader will be counted when checking the Limit.
The action ends only when a player loses a card.
If the player who drew the Master Decree loses their Leader during this card's action, the type of the last card that was their Leader remains.
The Manager's target does not activate the Master Decree.
If the Leader of the player who would break the Master Decree rule is stolen, the person who used the Catcher will be punished for breaking the Decree.
When playing as a duo, the action happens normally to your partner.
If you draw the Traitor, execute its action; if you remain alive, the number that will count for the Descendant is from the card played after the Traitor
The Manager's target does not activate the Descendant.
If the Leader of the player who would break the Descendant rule is stolen, the person who used the Catcher will be punished for breaking the Descendant.
If there are fewer than four active players at the table, the Duties action is extended for 2 rounds.
If a player completes one of the duties but is eliminated before the end of the Decree, the duty is considered completed, but the player does not receive the reward.
The Manager's target does not activate the Duties.
No special cases found.
No special cases found.
It is not possible to use Reactive cards to defend against Zombies.
For the Comparator's action, draw a card and after the action discard it, even if you win.
For the Speculator's action, draw a card and after the action discard it, even if you win.
The Reserve card must be discarded at the end of the action.
The Immortal functions as a Guardian for Zombies during Halloween, see the Guardian's cases if in doubt.
When playing as a duo, the action happens normally to your partner.
Affects only players who died during the Death Tax Measure
Players with no coins lose nothing.
Cards that need to draw from the draw pile will be played without action. Cards: *Angel, Cartomancer, Advanced Cartomancer, Oracle, Advanced Oracle, Dealer, Sneaky and Advanced Sneaky.*

If a player who has already played during the inertia turn loses their last card, they are not eliminated; they must draw 2 cards in the next round and use one of them, thus having only one card in hand. The one who eliminated the card also does not gain a coin, because the player was not eliminated.
If Scarcity is in effect, the Law of Inertia is not activated.
Trades can only be made between players.
If you guess the card correctly with the Seer, the target only replaces it in the next round. If the Player runs out of cards, they cannot be a target until they replace their cards.
If Sacrifice is used during Inertia, the player only replaces the card in the next round. If the Player runs out of cards, they cannot be a target until they replace their cards.
If the player has only the Gossiper, they can play it without action.

Reactive cards that need to replace from the draw pile, are replaced in the next round. If the Player runs out of cards, they cannot be a target until they replace their cards. Cards: *Catcher, Two-Faced, Bodyguard and Reflex.*
After performing the Poisoner's action, you only replace the card in the next round. If you run out of cards, you cannot be a target until you replace your cards.
If the Virus is activated during Inertia, the targets only discard one card, not all. If they only have one card, they are eliminated.
The Manipulator's target must replace the card in the next round. If the Player runs out of cards, they cannot be a target until they replace their cards.
The Advanced Troublemaker can perform its action normally, since no card is removed from the draw pile.
The action of swapping a card with the Secret Agent cannot be executed during Inertia; use it as a common Spy.
*Spy:* SEE the cards in a player's hand.
When playing as a duo, your partner cannot use your stored card during Repetition.
No special cases found.
*REFLECT:* The Reflex can be used to reverse the direction as soon as the Law of Return card is played. It can be used by any player, regardless of turn.
Leaders already on the table count.
The Manager's target does not activate the Diversity Measure.
If the Leader of the player who would break the Diversity Measure rule is stolen, the person who used the Catcher will be punished for breaking the Diversity Measure.
You cannot defend yourself from the player who is choosing your Leader, because this is a Measure action.
Does not activate the Lover.
If the chosen card is blocked by the Dictator, it is played without action.
If the chosen card is the Gossiper, it is played without action.
If you draw the Traitor, execute its action before the player chooses their Leader.
If a player passes the Virus, *ALL* players participate in the Virus action, except the one who had it at the start of the Measure's action.
The player who draws the card must look at the card they drew.
Can place a card on their own Leader, if it hasn't already been filled by the Measure's action.
The player's current Leader must go to the Field or the Discard pile, depending on its type.
The Chaos Measure action does not consume a turn, so Turn cards lasting only one turn do not lose their power. Cards: *Arbiter, Dictator and Guardian.*

Does not activate the Traitor; the player who receives it as Leader must perform its action. The Player must play another Leader and execute its action without drawing a new card, and may be eliminated if they run out of cards.
Players blocked by the Arbiter also participate in the Chaos Measure action.
There are no protections against Constitution; players with protection cards on their Leader or Field also participate in the action.
No special cases found.
Card actions can be blocked normally.
The Shooter must say only one character for everyone at the table.
Zombies are not affected by the Measure; they must continue using numbers.
If you guess the Wanted correctly, or another card of a player who has the Wanted, it is activated normally.
The Discriminator must also choose a character instead of the type; if correct, the player is eliminated.
If the target has the Forger, it must be guessed as the player's current Leader.
If the target has the Lover, it protects all characters, unless you say Lover, then the player is eliminated.
If the previous player has no card in their Leader, it counts as zero.
The Manager's target does not activate the Strongest Measure.
If you steal a player's Leader, but the Leader of the player before you is of higher value, you will have to reveal your sum at the end of the turn.
There is no protection against the Constitution power.
If the previous player has no card in their Leader, it counts as zero.
The Manager's target does not activate the Weakest Measure.
If you steal a player's Leader, but the Leader of the player before you is of lower value, you will have to reveal your sum at the end of the turn.
There is no protection against the Constitution power.
Be careful with the chosen target; if you are adjacent to them, the action will also happen to you.
If the adjacent player is protected or dead, they do not participate; if both are, the action happens only with the target.
The player who used the Opportunist chooses the seat where each of the affected players should sit.
Draw a number of cards equal to the number of targets who will participate in the action. Place one card in the Reserve of each of them.
The Next Measure power applies only to the card drawn by the Manipulator's power, and not to the Manipulator itself.
The Next Measure power applies only to the card copied by the Shapeshifter's power, and not to the Shapeshifter itself.
Swap the card of one target at a time, so the previous target's card will already be part of the Graveyard.
If you choose yourself, execute the Necromancer's action with the players adjacent to you.
If only the players adjacent to the target have the chosen number, the Advanced Seer's action ends, but the coins count.
The Detective's action is valid with the hand cards of each participant in the Next Measure. Infiltrator and Secret Agent are affected normally.
Players adjacent to the Angel's target gain a card if they don't have the maximum number of cards allowed in hand at the moment.
Global cards are not affected by the Next Measure power. Cards: *Troublemaker, Advanced Troublemaker, Shooter, Advanced Cartomancer, Advanced Politician and Advanced Sneaky.*
Cards that only attack Fields are not affected by the Next Measure power. Cards: *Judge, Thief, Usurper and Advanced Usurper.*
Cards that do not have players as targets are not affected by the Next Measure power. Cards: *Cartomancer, Dictator, Oracle, Advanced Oracle and Dealer.*

Adjacent players also participate in the comparison. Only the player with the *HIGHEST* sum loses a card.
Adjacent players also participate in the comparison. Only the player with the *LOWEST* sum loses a card.
If the adjacent players have no Permanent or Turn cards and no Reserve, they are not affected by the Judge.
If the adjacent players have no Permanent or Turn cards and no Reserve, steal another card and place it in your Reserve; however, if you already have a reserve, the player is not affected.
The Usurper does not activate the Next Measure.
The Gossiper is not an Immediate card, so it does not activate the Next Measure.
If you choose someone to swap with the deck, the adjacent people must do the same afterwards, including you if applicable.
If you choose two people to swap cards, it does not activate the Next Measure.
The Cambist has three targets and should not activate the Next Measure.
The Advanced Dealer does not activate the Next Measure.

steps.2: *Example:* You sent an Immediate, Target 1 Immediate, Target 2 Reactive, Target 3 Automatic. You received a different one and lose the card, Target 1 received the same, loses the card, Target 2 and 3 received different ones, keep their cards.

steps.1: If an Opportunist is used during the Next Measure, the players adjacent to the target swap places with each other.

Attack one target at a time, following the special cases of the card you use.
Cannot choose the same player twice. If there is only one possible target, do not perform the second action.
If there are no available targets, loses the action.
Does not work for Zombies.
If eliminated on the first target, does not attack the second.
If the first target defends, but you remain alive, attack the second target.
If you lose the comparison to the first target, but you remain alive, attack the second target.
Only works for the Shapeshifter if the copied card has only one target.

During this Measure, if the target would be eliminated for having the Lover, they must only reveal it to the entire table, keep it, and draw a new card.
During this Measure, if the Wanted is activated, the player must show the Wanted, keep it, draw a new card, and gain one coin.
If the Virus is activated during this Measure, players must reveal one card, keep it, and draw a new one.
If a Kidnapper is used to react to your action, after having your card stolen, draw two cards to replace and show one of them.
If a Two-Faced is used to react to your action, show the card chosen by it to everyone and draw a new one.
If the Traitor is activated during this Measure, discard it and draw two cards to replace; then, if it is your turn, play without needing to draw a new one.
In *COMPARISON* actions, the loser shows one card and draws another. Cards: *Incendiary, Poor and Rich.*
In the Comparator's action, the winner discards their card and draws a new one; the loser keeps the revealed card and draws one more.
In the Speculator's action, the loser reveals the exchanged card and draws one more.
Actions that only swap the card are not affected. Cards: *Secret Agent, Advanced Cartomancer, Discriminator, Manipulator, Necromancer, Negotiator, Sacrifice, Advanced Dealer and Seer.*
If you are the target of the Beggar, execute the action normally and then draw two cards to replace.
If there are not enough cards in the Discard pile, continue the game until there are enough cards and only then activate this Measure.
If a player already has a Reserve card, discard it and replace it with the Measure's card.
If the old Leader is of the Permanent or Turn type, its power is deactivated and it goes to the Reserve to be used again soon.
If the card to be used during the Replay is blocked by the Dictator, it must be played without action.
Protected players participate normally; there are no protections against Measure.
If the card to be used in the Replay is the Traitor, use it normally.

Reactive and Automatic cards played due to their prerequisites do not count towards eliminating the Sovereign. However, if they are played as Leader on the player's turn, they count. Cards: *Loan Shark, Catcher, Two-Faced, Poisoner, Forger, Gossiper, Bodyguard, Impostor, Intrusive, Reflex, Kidnapper, Traitor and Virus.*
Cards with value -1 add 1 life point to the Sovereign. Cards: *Catcher, Two-Faced, Impostor, Reflex and Kidnapper.*
No special cases found.

Cards that interact with the Leader must consider the top card in the pile. At the end of the Tributes, the player's Leader must be the top card in the pile. Cards: *Advanced Helper, Poisoner, Forger, Manager, Intimidator, Politician and Cheater.*

Leaders of the Permanent or Turn type lose their power when covered. If they are already in the Permanent area, they should not be covered. At the end of the Tributes, the one who should keep the Permanent or Turn card is the owner of the Leader.
Even if you play your card on another player's Leader, the action must be performed by you.

Cards that interact with other cards that are on a player's Field can choose any card from the pile. Cards: *Advanced Troublemaker, Cambist, Informant, Judge, Thief, Shapeshifter, Advanced Sneaky, Advanced Dealer and Usurper.*
The Guardian can be covered by another player, losing its power.
Even with Security in their Permanent area, the player cannot prevent their Leader from being covered.
Eliminated players can have their Leaders covered, but do not receive any prize for having the tallest pile; in this situation, no one should be rewarded.
Reactive and Automatic cards that meet their prerequisites during this Decree should go directly to the discard pile.
If covered, the Entrepreneur with investment loses its investment.
The Manager's target does not activate the Tributes.
If the Leader of the player who would break the Tributes rule is stolen, the person who used the Catcher will be punished for breaking the Tribute.
Leaders already on the table count.
The Manager's target does not activate the Exchange Rate Variation.
If the Leader of the player who would break the Exchange Rate Variation rule is stolen, the person who used the Catcher will be punished for breaking the Exchange Rate Variation.
